title: KADE Protocol Event
description: Structured event envelope for IoT devices, perception models, and agentic systems.

source.description: Identifier for the emitter. Convention: <model>.<instance> or <sensor>.<id>.

type.description: High-level event category (e.g. detection, sensor_read, command, fault, heartbeat).

label.description: Specific event name within the type.

confidence.description: Probability in [0, 1] for stochastic sources. Omit for deterministic sensors.

zone.description: Logical location. Decouples events from physical device identity.

meta.description: Free-form source-specific data. Consumers ignore unknown fields.
